praise.vi_note: བསྟོད་པ. Tán thán (讚歎) is the usual Vietnamese Buddhist word and the Gemini draft's; the Chinese 讚頌 would be tán tụng, which is less common.

perfect_buddha.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + standard Buddhist term
perfect_buddha.vi_note: 正等正覺 (samyaksaṃbuddha). Gemini writes Chính Đẳng Chính Giác; Vietnamese Buddhist usage and the graded-translate register table (chánh niệm) use Chánh.

lightning.vi_note: གློག. Gemini paraphrased ("chớp sáng tựa luồng điện xẹt"); tia chớp is the plain word. Chinese 閃電.

world.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + Gemini vi draft
world.vi_note: 世界 thế giới; Gemini 1-5, 1-17. Not cõi, which Vietnamese uses for realm (ཁམས, as in ba cõi / dục giới) — the same distinction the Chinese keeps (世界 vs 三界).

face.vi_source: standard Buddhist term + Gemini vi draft
face.vi_note: ཞལ. Gemini gương mặt (1-1, 1-2, 1-8), the plain modern word; Hán-Việt dung nhan is literary.

lotus.vi_source: standard Buddhist term + Gemini vi draft
lotus.vi_note: ཆུ་སྐྱེས / པདྨ. Locks the core word so hoa sen, đóa sen, sen thủy sinh all fit.

lotus_face.vi_note: 1-8 only (her own face, likened to a lotus), as settled in the English fact-check. Gemini has the same phrase there.

light.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + Gemini vi draft
light.vi_note: འོད. Hán-Việt 光 quang, as in hào quang / quang minh, which Gemini uses (1-2, 1-9, 1-12). Locked short so the compound can vary.

blaze.vi_note: འབར. Rực covers rực cháy (fire, 1-7, 1-13) and rực sáng (light, 1-2); Gemini has rực rỡ / rực cháy. The Hán-Việt xí nhiên (熾燃) is not used in prayers.

moon.vi_source: standard Buddhist term + Gemini vi draft
moon.vi_note: ཟླ་བ and the kenning རི་དགས་རྟགས་ཅན (1-18): vầng trăng, trăng thu, trăng khuyết. Gemini throughout.

peace.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + Gemini vi draft
peace.vi_note: ཞི / ཞི་བ = 寂靜 tịch tĩnh (Gemini 1-3). Gemini used an bình / bình an in 1-15 and 1-21; one form is locked.

without_exception.vi_note: མ་ལུས. The Hán-Việt of the Chinese 無餘 (vô dư) is not understood by general readers; không sót is the plain word Gemini uses (1-5, 1-8).

hum.vi_note: Latin, without diacritics, as Vietnamese Vajrayana practitioners write it (Tenkal's choice).

feet.vi_note: ཞབས: bàn chân. Note for the drift check: chân is also in chân ngôn (mantra) and chân như (suchness); neither occurs in the verses where feet is locked (1-5, 1-14, 1-17).

tuttare.vi_note: ཏུཏྟྭ་ར. Latin, as in Om Tare Tuttare Ture Soha. Gemini wrote Tuttara in 1-5, 1-10, 1-20.

hosts.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + Gemini vi draft
hosts.vi_note: ཚོགས = 眾 chúng (chúng dạ-xoa, chúng thần).

spirit.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + standard Buddhist term
spirit.vi_note: འབྱུང་པོ (bhūta). Hán-Việt of the Chinese 鬼神, the ordinary Vietnamese word for spirits. Gemini tinh linh reads as "sprites". Kept distinct from ác quỷ (གདོན). Commentary check: DG, GD, TN name Gaṇapati (ཚོགས་བདག) as their chief; TN: obstructers and misleaders. Quỷ thần fits.

destroy.vi_source: standard Buddhist term + Gemini vi draft
destroy.vi_note: འཇོམས; Gemini 1-8, 1-13, 1-15, 1-21. The Hán-Việt of 摧毀 (tồi hủy) is not used.

supreme.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + Gemini vi draft
supreme.vi_note: རབ in 1-10 (supreme joy): 極 cực — cực hỷ.

power.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + Gemini vi draft
power.vi_note: དབང in 1-10: 攝伏 nhiếp phục; Gemini has exactly this ("Nhiếp phục ác ma"). The commentaries read it as bringing under her control. Commentary check: all four read དབང་དུ་མཛད as bringing under her control. Nhiếp phục fits.

joy.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + Gemini vi draft
joy.vi_note: དགའ: 喜 hỷ, locked short so hoan hỷ / cực hỷ fit; Gemini hoan hỷ in 1-10, 1-13, 1-16, 1-19.

syllable_hum.vi_note: ཡི་གེ་ཧཱུཾ; Vietnamese puts chữ before the syllable.

ability.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + Gemini vi draft
ability.vi_note: ནུས: 能力 năng lực; Gemini 1-11 ("có năng lực triệu thỉnh"). Also 1-5 (same ནུས), as in Chinese.

perfectly_endowed.vi_note: ཡང་དག་ལྡན (1-15, 1-21). The Hán-Việt of 圓滿具足 (viên mãn cụ túc) is literary; viên mãn đầy đủ is clear and keeps both locked parts.

endowed.vi_note: ལྡན. Plain word; the Hán-Việt cụ túc (具足) is literary.

mantra.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list + Gemini vi draft
mantra.vi_note: སྔགས = 咒 chú: căn bản chú (1-22), chú mười chữ and minh chú (1-16). Gemini also had chân ngôn once; one form is locked.

goddess.vi_note: ལྷ་མོ (2-1); Gemini left it out. Gendun Drub and Taranatha identify it with Tārā herself (see the Chinese note). Nữ Thần is the plain word for a goddess. Reviewer: if it reads as a folk goddess, Thánh Mẫu or Tôn nữ are options.

vetala.vi_source: Sino-Vietnamese reading of the zh word list
vetala.vi_note: རོ་ལངས ("risen corpse"): Hán-Việt of 起屍, the term in Vietnamese Mật tông texts. Gemini thây ma means "corpse / zombie" — the reading the English fact-check rejected.
